sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Thursday this tab went 2-0 (Colts-Texans Under, Knicks). Today: two college picks where two sources agree.

straight.reasoning: RotoWire and BetMGM both take Indiana. Kentucky's defense ranks about 100th in KenPom and it nearly lost at home to Northern Arizona, while undefeated Indiana's offense is top-30 and just beat Arkansas. The line has moved from -2.5 to -3.5, so get -3 if you can. Playable to -3.5; skip at -4.
Dimers' biggest edge of the day (63% to cover), and BetMGM agrees. Illinois isn't fully healthy and is coming off its big win at Duke, so expect a letdown and lots of bench minutes. Playable to +48.
